svg.aria-label: A heavy rust-colored inspection block, arrows and brackets emphasize four bare pots on the right; six growing pots remain visible on the left.
svg.title: Pessimism — fixed starter, different additions
svg.text: Four gaps take over the page.
An inspection sheet focused on missing growth
But this view gives them less emphasis.
My thought: the missing growth dominates my view.
So I build a heavier frame around the four bare pots.
Nothing has become worse. The emphasis has changed.
